sections.heading: Daily prophecies
sections.body: Daily prophecy slots present a choice of objectives. Select one for each available slot, then perform the described activity elsewhere in the game. Progress updates automatically when qualifying actions are recorded.

sections.heading: Weekly Favor and revelations
sections.body: Completing prophecy objectives contributes to weekly progression. Revelation milestones and greater prophecies provide additional goals and rewards; the page shows current progress and any choices still required.

sections.heading: Claims, caches, and expiry
sections.body: Completed objectives must be claimed where a claim action is shown. Reward caches remain listed until opened. Daily and weekly content follows its displayed reset cycle, so review incomplete and unclaimed entries before expiry.
